name: 32218 · Jacksonville, FL
findings: ZIP 32218 (Jacksonville) has 225 nonprofit organizations. 80 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 62 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (51% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 32218 (Jacksonville) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.text: 28 religious organizations here list public events, compared with about 13 in similar places of this size.
